shell.title: Maker panel
shell.no_org: You are not a member of a manufacturer organization
shell.no_org_hint: Ask your organization's administrator to invite you as product manager, production operator or support.

auth.lead: Define products, register devices, labels, warranty and support.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: {org}'s devices from registration to activation
dashboard.no_products: You have not defined a product yet.
dashboard.no_firmware: No device has reported a firmware version yet.
dashboard.no_trend: No data for the trend yet.

products.subtitle: {n} products
products.new_subtitle: Define a product once; register thousands of devices from it.
products.code_help: Upper-case letters, digits and dashes; never changes later.
products.pattern_help: Each device's identifier comes from this pattern; {0000} is the counter (e.g. CTRL-8R-{0000}).
products.created: Product created; now define its inputs and outputs
products.step_1: Set the details and the identifier pattern.
products.step_2: Define inputs, outputs and parameters (e.g. 8 relays).
products.step_3: Set the protocols and each parameter's address, then publish the version.
products.step_4: Register devices in batches and print the QR labels.

product.name: Product name
product.kind_help: An edge hub connects other equipment (e.g. industrial gear) behind it.
product.pattern_fixed: The pattern is fixed once the first device is registered.
product.catalog: In the public catalog (any buyer may add it behind their edge hub)
product.catalog_help: For equipment the buyer installs (meters, inverters, PLCs, …).
product.picture_help: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 512 KB; also shown in the buyer's app.
product.publish_confirm: Publish version {n}? A published version never changes; any later change is a new version.
product.published_ok: Published; you can register devices now
product.draft_saved: Draft of version {n} saved and validated

io.title: Inputs, outputs and variables
io.empty: No parameter yet. Use “Add a group” to create e.g. 8 relays at once.
io.footnote: A key never changes after publishing; the display name can change any time. Every parameter is read-only by default.
io.pick: Pick a row to edit it.
io.key_locked: In a published version; fixed to keep the history.
io.states_help: One per line: value=label (for enumerations like auto/manual).
io.bad_key: A key has only lower-case letters, digits and _
io.need_name: At least one display name is needed
io.delete_published: {key} is in a published version; removing it in the next version is a breaking change for devices. Continue?
io.mapping_help: Every protocol's full addresses are on the Protocols tab.
io.controllable: Controllable from the app (outputs and parameters)
io.formula_help: With this product's keys, e.g. power * 1000 or integrate(power) for energy. Keys: {keys}
io.need_formula: A calculated parameter needs a formula
io.calculated_note: The hub computes this parameter from the others; it has no protocol address and the device does not send it. Units are checked on saving.
io.role_help: For an AC or thermostat: tags with a climate role (and the same group) become one panel in the buyer's app: on/off, mode, set point, fan speed, room temperature.
io.icon_help: For inputs (433 MHz remote, PIR, magnet, smoke detector, IR, missed call) the buyer's app shows the state with this icon in plain words; smoke, leaks and motion in the alert colour.

commands.title: Commands
commands.empty: No output or parameter to command.
commands.footnote: Only controllable parameters take commands. Each command passes the control-safety layer (permission, range, audit) and the device confirms its execution.
commands.timeout_help: A command the device has not confirmed by then is recorded as unanswered.
commands.timeout_native: Set for the native device protocol; add it on the Protocols tab first.

protocols.intro: For each protocol set the connection defaults and every parameter's address. A device adds only what is its own (e.g. its IP) when registered.
protocols.no_connection_fields: This protocol has no connection settings.
protocols.native_tags: In the native protocol each parameter comes with its own key in the JSON message; no address is needed.
protocols.no_tag_fields: This protocol needs no address fields.

versions.title: Template versions
versions.footnote: A published version is fixed. Devices can move to a newer version; the history of shared parameters is kept.
versions.automations: {n} buyer scenes or automations use a removed parameter.
versions.notes_help: What changed in this version (saved with the draft).

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.footnote: Devices fetch the image with their own credential and must check its SHA-256 before installing.
firmware.min_template_help: Optional; only devices on this template version or later.
firmware.need_file: A file and a version number are needed
firmware.rollout_confirm: Offer version {v} to every device of this product?
firmware.no_jobs: Not offered to any device yet.
firmware.withdraw_confirm: Withdraw version {v}? Devices that have not installed it will not get it.

production.enabled: Ready to connect from the start
production.codes_note: Every device gets its own connection credential and activation code. Codes are shown once, in the label export.
production.csv_batch: This batch's CSV for the line
production.no_version: This product has no published version yet.
production.privacy: For privacy the maker never sees the buyer or their usage data; only activation and device health.
production.stage_title: Move a batch to a stage
production.stage_confirm: Move every device of batch {batch} to “{stage}”? Devices a buyer activated keep their stage.
production.stage_help: E.g. mark a batch “sold” once it is shipped to the dealer.

labels.subtitle: One-time activation codes, QR and the production-line file
labels.with_credentials: With the device connection credential (to flash on the line)
labels.credentials_help: The credential is only in this file; issuing again voids the earlier one.
labels.replace_note: Issuing again voids the earlier codes of the same devices. Labels printed before stop working.
labels.issue_confirm: Issue new activation codes? The earlier codes of these devices stop working.
labels.issue_confirm_credentials: Issue new activation codes and connection credentials? The earlier ones stop working and the devices need the new credential.
labels.unknown_id: {id} is not a device of this product
labels.qr_help: The QR holds the identifier and the activation code. Scanning it in the app links exactly this device to the buyer's account.
labels.pdf_help: Pick “Save as PDF” in the print dialog.
labels.once: These codes are shown only this once. Print or save before leaving this page.

device.connection_help: This device's own settings; merged with the template defaults.
device.stage_help: “Active” comes only from the buyer's activation.
device.reset_confirm: Every buyer access and share ends and a new activation code is made. Continue?
device.disable_confirm: Disable the device? Until enabled again no buyer can activate it.

warranty.subtitle: Warranty starts at the buyer's first activation
warranty.footnote: Change a device's warranty on its own page.

support.subtitle: Look a device up by identifier or serial and solve its problem
support.not_found: No device with this identifier or serial.
support.read_only: Your role can only look; actions need a product manager or production operator.
support.new_code_confirm: Issue a new code? The code on the label stops working.
support.new_code_help: Give this code to the buyer; it is shown once.
support.d_blocked: The device is blocked; it cannot be activated or connect until unblocked.
support.d_not_claimed: Sold, but the buyer has not activated it in the app yet.
support.d_in_stock: Not with a buyer yet (in stock).
support.d_not_enabled: The device's connection is off; use “Enable connection” on its page.
support.d_never_connected: The device never connected: check its credential, network and server address.
support.d_offline: The device is offline now; check power and internet at the site.
support.d_offline_long: Offline for more than 3 days; likely broken or moved to another network.
support.d_no_firmware: The device has not reported its firmware version.
support.d_ok: The device is online and nothing looks wrong.
support.g1_q: The buyer's code does not work
support.g1_a: The label may have been voided by a re-issue, or 5 wrong tries locked it for a while. Issue a new code.
support.g2_q: The device belongs to someone else
support.g2_a: The previous owner uses “Transfer to a new owner” in the app; otherwise a factory reset.
support.g3_q: The device does not come online
support.g3_a: Flash the connection credential again (issue labels with credentials).
support.g4_a: After a factory reset, block it so nobody can activate it.

settings.no_permission: Only a product manager manages members.
settings.invite_help: The invitation link goes by email and is valid for 7 days.
settings.role_manufacturer_admin: Products, versions, firmware, device registration and members
settings.role_production_operator: Register devices, labels and device stages
settings.role_manufacturer_support: Look at products and devices for support
settings.name: Name

errors.account_locked: The account is locked for a while
errors.conflict: Not possible in the current state
errors.invalid_template: The product template is not valid
errors.not_draft: This version is not a draft
errors.no_binding: This version has no such protocol
errors.invalid_identifier: The identifier or range is not valid
errors.invalid_pattern: The identifier pattern is not valid
errors.image_too_large: The picture is larger than 512 KB
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests; try again shortly

composite.title: Multi-parameter commands
composite.intro: One button in the buyer's app that sets several parameters; each passes the control-safety layer.
composite.help: Write 1 or 0 for on/off; an empty value is entered by the buyer when sending.
composite.need_param: At least one parameter is needed

tickets.pick: Pick a ticket to read and answer.
tickets.privacy: The buyer sent this ticket; only their name is shown.

brand.title: Brand
brand.name: Brand name
brand.app_link: The app with your brand (for the box or manual):

billing.title: Billing and plan
billing.over_limit: Active devices exceed the plan's limit ({n}).
billing.change_help: Ask the platform administrator to change the plan; payment happens outside the platform.
